scope: TUI unsent draft selection, modal priority, SSH clipboard routing and related regression checks

checks_per_scenario: Esc clears selection and preserves draft
pty.ssh_additional_check: Ctrl+C emits exact original selection in OSC 52, shows Sent feedback and preserves the live draft

corrected_test_failure.failure: Selection ended before x because the fixture treated Tab as zero columns
corrected_test_failure.resolution: Use the renderer's one-column Tab/CR string widths; keep exact original-text assertions

limitations: OS clipboard side effect was not executed; local and fallback routes use injected writers in unit tests
SSH behavior was simulated in isolated PTYs; OSC 52 was captured, not forwarded to a real terminal
Full workspace tests and cross-platform CI were not run as part of this selection verification
